key_insight: Real-time bidding couples budget-aware control with learning because bids determine both auction outcomes and which market-clearing prices are observed.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports advertising bid policies that balance campaign performance, transaction margins, budget use and information gathering.
method: Model bidding as continuous-time stochastic control with a latent price process.
Estimate prices through parallel exploratory subcampaigns using bounded randomized bids.
Develop model-based calibration with HJB policy iteration and a physics-informed neural network, alongside observable-information, entropy-regularized actor-critic learning.
evidence_signal: Synthetic experiments illustrate the estimator and computational methods; under a stylized sampling model, the estimator is consistent with mean-square error of order 1/N.
watch_item: The estimation guarantee relies on stylized sampling assumptions, and estimated-price policies remain distinct from solving the genuinely partially observed control problem.
paper_title: Media Trading with Censored Auction Prices: A Stochastic Control and Reinforcement Learning Approach
